highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.1 improves Apple view reliability and fixes unpackaged WinUI applications.
highlights_body: This servicing release also adds typeface PostScript names, corrects UTC date conversion, and makes canvas restoration safer after disposal.

bullets.detail: Avoids initializing SKMetalView twice, fixes Metal on iOS 15 and earlier, and preserves SKXamlCanvas transparency on Mac Catalyst.

bullets.lead: Safe canvas restoration and UTC handling
bullets.detail: SKAutoCanvasRestore avoids crashing when the canvas has already been disposed. Date conversion handles UTC inputs rather than assuming every DateTime is local.
Corrects the EGL and GLESv2 build configuration for unpackaged WinUI apps and statically links the WinUI interop runtime.
Adds SKTypeface.PostScriptName for identifying a font's PostScript name.
Refreshes bundled zlib to a 1.3.0.1-based revision.

contributor_summaries.jeremy-visionaid: Metal view initialization, Metal context disposal coverage, and UTC date conversion.
contributor_summaries.taublast: Safe canvas restoration after disposal and Metal compatibility on older iOS versions.
contributor_summaries.spouliot: Transparent SKXamlCanvas rendering on Mac Catalyst.

preview_summaries.v3.119.1-preview.1.1: Added typeface PostScript names and fixes for Apple views, canvas disposal, UTC conversion, and unpackaged WinUI applications.
